announcements.text: BlueForge Alliance, Bryan, Texas, was awarded a $400,000,000 firm-fixed-price modification to a previously awarded contract (N00024-24-C-2135) to support planning, resourcing, coordinating, and uplifting the Submarine Industrial Base. Work will be performed in Bryan, Texas, and is expected to be completed by September 2027. Non-appropriated funds in the amount of $200,000,000 (50%); fiscal 2026 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) funds in the amount of $144,963,691 (36%); and fiscal 2025 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) funding in the amount of $50,000,000 (13%), will be obligated at time of award and will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year. Naval Sea Systems Command, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Air Center Helicopters Inc.* Burleson, Texas, was awarded an $82,842,593 firm-fixed-price contract (N3220526C1236) to provide Vertical Replenishment (VERTREP) services. The Detachment will be forward deployed worldwide for extensive periods at sea. It is anticipated that the detachment will be primarily assigned to Combat Logistics Force ships of the T-AKE class and used to meet Seventh and Fifth Fleet requirements. The contract contains a one-year base period, four one-year option periods, and an option to extend services for up to six months in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation 52.217-8. This contract will be funded incrementally in accordance with Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement 252.232-7007 using Navy appropriated funds that do not expire. Contract performance will commence on July 25, 2026, and will conclude on Jan. 24, 2032, if all options are exercised. The procurement was solicited via the Government Point of Entry website, and one proposal was received. Military Sealift Command, Norfolk, Virginia, is the contracting activity.

extracted.description: Vertical Replenishment (VERTREP) services for Combat Logistics Force ships
extracted.competition: one proposal received; solicited via Government Point of Entry website

announcements.text: Detyens Shipyard Inc.,* North Charleston, South Carolina, is awarded a $13,425,560 firm-fixed-price contract (N3220526C0007) for the 90-calendar day shipyard availability for the post-shakedown availability of Military Sealift Command's expeditionary fast transport vessel USNS Point Loma (T-EPF 15). This contract includes a base work package and two unexercised options for additional work and time which, if exercised, would increase the cumulative value of this contract to $13,458,685. Work will be performed in North Charleston, South Carolina, beginning Aug. 3, 2026, and is expected to be completed by Oct. 31, 2026. Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance (Navy) funds in the amount of $13,425,560.00 are obligated and will expire at the end of the fiscal year. This contract was competitively procured with proposals solicited via the Government wide Point of Entry website and two offers were received. Military Sealift Command, Norfolk, Virginia, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Raytheon Co., Segundo, California, has been awarded a $15,868,698 modification (FA8119-26-F-0022-P00001) to a previously awarded contract (FA8119-23-D-0002) for the procurement of versatile diagnostics automatic validation support services for B-2 contract maintenance depot program. Tinker Air Force Sustainment Center, Tinker Air Force Base, Oklahoma, is the contracting activity.
